<h2 id="概述">概述</h2>
<p>本文档通过<strong>职工管理</strong>（Employee）的实际代码示例，展示如何使用CodeSpirit框架快速开发CRUD功能。该示例来自身份认证系统（IdentityApi），是一个标准的关联型CRUD模块，包含完整的验证逻辑、业务处理和关联关系管理。</p>
<p><strong>最后更新</strong>: 2025年12月22日<br>
<strong>框架版本</strong>: v2.0.0<br>
<strong>示例来源</strong>: <code>CodeSpirit.IdentityApi</code> - 职工管理模块</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/70544/202512/70544-20251223170219569-281479304.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="开发流程概览">开发流程概览</h2>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    A["1. 创建实体模型"] --&gt; B["2. 创建DTO类"]
    B --&gt; C["3. 配置AutoMapper"]
    C --&gt; D["4. 创建服务层"]
    D --&gt; E["5. 创建控制器"]
    E --&gt; F["6. 配置数据库"]
    F --&gt; G["7. 创建迁移"]
    G --&gt; H["完成"]
</div><h2 id="示例模块说明">示例模块说明</h2>
<p><strong>职工管理</strong>（Employee）是一个典型的关联型CRUD模块，具有以下特点：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 关联关系管理（部门、用户账号）</li>
<li>✅ 完整的CRUD操作</li>
<li>✅ 业务验证（工号唯一性、部门存在性、身份证格式等）</li>
<li>✅ 多条件查询（关键字、部门、状态、日期范围等）</li>
<li>✅ 表单分组展示（基本信息、联系方式、工作信息等）</li>
<li>✅ 多租户支持</li>
<li>✅ 审计字段自动记录</li>
<li>✅ 软删除支持</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="1-创建实体模型">1. 创建实体模型</h2>
<p>在<code>Data/Models</code>目录下创建实体类：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Data/Models/Employee.cs
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Entities.Interfaces;
using CodeSpirit.MultiTenant.Abstractions;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工信息
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class Employee : IFullAuditable, IMultiTenant, IIsActive
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职工ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public long Id { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 租户ID（多租户支持）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required]
    [MaxLength(50)]
    public string TenantId { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 工号（租户内唯一）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required]
    [MaxLength(50)]
    public string EmployeeNo { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 姓名
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required]
    [MaxLength(100)]
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 性别
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public Gender Gender { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 身份证号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(18)]
    public string? IdNo { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 出生日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public DateTime? BirthDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 手机号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(15)]
    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 电子邮箱
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100)]
    [EmailAddress]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 部门ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 所属部门（导航属性）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public Department? Department { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职位
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100)]
    public string? Position { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职级
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(50)]
    public string? JobLevel { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 入职日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public DateTime? HireDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 离职日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public DateTime? TerminationDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 在职状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public EmploymentStatus EmploymentStatus { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 关联的用户ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public long? UserId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 关联的用户账号（导航属性）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public ApplicationUser? User { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 紧急联系人
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100)]
    public string? EmergencyContact { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 紧急联系电话
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(15)]
    public string? EmergencyPhone { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(500)]
    public string? Address { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 备注
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(1000)]
    public string? Remarks { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 是否激活
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 头像地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(255)]
    [DataType(DataType.ImageUrl)]
    public string? AvatarUrl { get; set; }

    // 审计字段（实现IFullAuditable接口）
    public long CreatedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public long? UpdatedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
    public long? DeletedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DeletedAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsDeleted { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>实现<code>IFullAuditable</code>接口，自动包含完整的审计字段（创建、更新、删除）</li>
<li>实现<code>IMultiTenant</code>接口，支持多租户数据隔离</li>
<li>实现<code>IIsActive</code>接口，支持激活状态管理</li>
<li>使用<code>long</code>作为主键类型</li>
<li>包含关联关系的导航属性（部门、用户账号）</li>
<li>支持软删除（<code>IsDeleted</code>字段）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="2-创建dto类">2. 创建DTO类</h2>
<p>在<code>Dtos/Employee</code>目录下创建DTO类：</p>
<h3 id="21-employeedto展示dto">2.1 EmployeeDto（展示DTO）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Dtos/Employee/EmployeeDto.cs
using CodeSpirit.Amis.Attributes.Columns;
using CodeSpirit.Core.Attributes;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工数据传输对象
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class EmployeeDto
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职工ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public long Id { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 工号
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("工号")]
    public string EmployeeNo { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 姓名
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("姓名")]
    [TplColumn(template: "${name}")]
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 头像地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("头像")]
    [AvatarColumn(Text = "${name}", Src = "${avatarUrl}")]
    [Badge(Animation = true, VisibleOn = "isActive", Level = "info")]
    public string? AvatarUrl { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 性别
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("性别")]
    public Gender Gender { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 手机号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("手机号码")]
    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 电子邮箱
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("电子邮箱")]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 部门ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [AmisColumn(Hidden = true)]
    public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 部门名称
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("部门")]
    public string? DepartmentName { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职位
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("职位")]
    public string? Position { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职级
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("职级")]
    public string? JobLevel { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 入职日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("入职日期")]
    [DateColumn(Format = "YYYY-MM-DD")]
    public DateTime? HireDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 在职状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("在职状态")]
    public EmploymentStatus EmploymentStatus { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 是否激活
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("是否激活")]
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 创建时间
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("创建时间")]
    [DateColumn(FromNow = true)]
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 更新时间
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("更新时间")]
    [DateColumn(FromNow = true)]
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<p><strong>列特性（Columns）</strong>：用于控制前端表格列的显示和格式</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>AmisColumn</code>：基础列特性，控制列的显示、排序、隐藏等</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Hidden</code>：是否隐藏列</li>
<li><code>Sortable</code>：是否支持排序</li>
<li><code>Copyable</code>：是否可复制</li>
<li><code>Fixed</code>：是否固定列（left/right/none）</li>
<li><code>StatusMapping</code>：状态映射（支持预定义映射如Boolean、HttpStatusCode等）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>TplColumn</code>：自定义列显示模板，使用模板语法自定义列内容</p>
<ul>
<li><code>template</code>：模板字符串，支持变量插值（如<code>${name}</code>）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AvatarColumn</code>：头像列，显示头像图片</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Text</code>：头像下方显示的文本</li>
<li><code>Src</code>：头像图片地址</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>DateColumn</code>：日期列，格式化日期显示</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Format</code>：日期格式（如<code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>、<code>YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm</code>）</li>
<li><code>FromNow</code>：是否显示相对时间（如"2小时前"）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>IgnoreColumn</code>：忽略列，该字段不在表格中显示</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>TagsColumn</code>：标签列，以标签形式显示数组数据</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>LinkColumn</code>：链接列，显示可点击的链接</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisStatusColumn</code>：状态列，显示状态标签和图标</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>LongTextColumn</code>：长文本列，支持展开/收起</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>ListColumn</code>：列表列，显示列表数据</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>IconColumn</code>：图标列，显示图标</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="22-createemployeedto创建dto">2.2 CreateEmployeeDto（创建DTO）</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/70544/202512/70544-20251223170338569-581617099.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Dtos/Employee/CreateEmployeeDto.cs
using CodeSpirit.Amis.Attributes.FormFields;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 创建职工数据传输对象
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
[FormGroup("basic", "基本信息", "EmployeeNo,Name,Gender,IdNo,BirthDate", Order = 1)]
[FormGroup("contact", "联系方式", "PhoneNumber,Email,Address", Order = 2)]
[FormGroup("work", "工作信息", "DepartmentId,Position,JobLevel,HireDate,EmploymentStatus", Order = 3)]
[FormGroup("relation", "关联信息", "UserId", Order = 4)]
[FormGroup("emergency", "紧急联系人", "EmergencyContact,EmergencyPhone", Order = 5)]
[FormGroup("other", "其他信息", "AvatarUrl,Remarks,IsActive", Order = 6)]
public class CreateEmployeeDto
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 工号
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "工号不能为空")]
    [MaxLength(50, ErrorMessage = "工号长度不能超过50个字符")]
    [DisplayName("工号")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string EmployeeNo { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 姓名
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "姓名不能为空")]
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "姓名长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [DisplayName("姓名")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 性别
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("性别")]
    [AmisFormField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public Gender Gender { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 身份证号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(18, ErrorMessage = "身份证号码长度不能超过18个字符")]
    [DisplayName("身份证号")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? IdNo { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 出生日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("出生日期")]
    [AmisDateFieldAttribute(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public DateTime? BirthDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 手机号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(15, ErrorMessage = "手机号码长度不能超过15个字符")]
    [Phone(ErrorMessage = "手机号码格式不正确")]
    [DisplayName("手机号码")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 电子邮箱
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "电子邮箱长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "电子邮箱格式不正确")]
    [DisplayName("电子邮箱")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 部门ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("部门")]
    [AmisInputTreeField(
        DataSource = "${ROOT_API}/api/identity/Departments/tree",
        LabelField = "name",
        ValueField = "id",
        Multiple = false,
        Searchable = true,
        ColumnRatio = 12
    )]
    public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职位
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "职位长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [DisplayName("职位")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? Position { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职级
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(50, ErrorMessage = "职级长度不能超过50个字符")]
    [DisplayName("职级")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? JobLevel { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 入职日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("入职日期")]
    [AmisDateFieldAttribute(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public DateTime? HireDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 在职状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("在职状态")]
    [AmisFormField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public EmploymentStatus EmploymentStatus { get; set; } = EmploymentStatus.Active;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 关联的用户ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("关联用户")]
    [AmisSelectField(
        Source = "${ROOT_API}/api/identity/Users",
        ValueField = "id",
        LabelField = "name",
        Multiple = false,
        Searchable = true,
        ColumnRatio = 12
    )]
    public long? UserId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 紧急联系人
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "紧急联系人长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [DisplayName("紧急联系人")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? EmergencyContact { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 紧急联系电话
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(15, ErrorMessage = "紧急联系电话长度不能超过15个字符")]
    [Phone(ErrorMessage = "紧急联系电话格式不正确")]
    [DisplayName("紧急联系电话")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? EmergencyPhone { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(500, ErrorMessage = "地址长度不能超过500个字符")]
    [DisplayName("地址")]
    [AmisTextareaField(ColumnRatio = 12)]
    public string? Address { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 头像地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(255, ErrorMessage = "头像地址长度不能超过255个字符")]
    [DisplayName("头像")]
    [AmisInputImageField(
        Receiver = "/file/api/file/images/upload?BucketName=avatar",
        Accept = "image/png,image/jpeg,image/jpg",
        MaxSize = 2097152,
        Multiple = false,
        ColumnRatio = 12
    )]
    public string? AvatarUrl { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 备注
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(1000, ErrorMessage = "备注长度不能超过1000个字符")]
    [DisplayName("备注")]
    [AmisTextareaField(ColumnRatio = 12)]
    public string? Remarks { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 是否激活
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("是否激活")]
    [AmisFormField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<p><strong>表单特性（FormFields）</strong>：用于控制前端表单字段的显示和交互</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>FormGroup</code>：表单分组特性，将相关字段组织成组</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Name</code>：组名称</li>
<li><code>Title</code>：组标题</li>
<li><code>Fields</code>：包含的字段名称（逗号分隔）</li>
<li><code>Order</code>：显示顺序（数值越小越靠前）</li>
<li><code>Mode</code>：显示模式（Normal/Inline/Horizontal）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisInputTextField</code>：文本输入框</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ColumnRatio</code>：字段宽度比例（12为全宽，6为半宽）</li>
<li><code>EnableAddOn</code>：是否启用右侧附加组件</li>
<li><code>AddOnLabel</code>：附加组件标签</li>
<li><code>AddOnApi</code>：附加组件API地址</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisInputTreeField</code>：树形选择组件</p>
<ul>
<li><code>DataSource</code>：数据源URL</li>
<li><code>ValueField</code>：值字段名</li>
<li><code>LabelField</code>：标签字段名</li>
<li><code>Multiple</code>：是否多选</li>
<li><code>Searchable</code>：是否可搜索</li>
<li><code>ShowOutline</code>：是否显示轮廓</li>
<li><code>SubmitOnChange</code>：选择后是否自动提交</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisSelectField</code>：下拉选择组件</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Source</code>：数据源URL</li>
<li><code>ValueField</code>：值字段名</li>
<li><code>LabelField</code>：标签字段名</li>
<li><code>Multiple</code>：是否多选</li>
<li><code>Searchable</code>：是否可搜索</li>
<li><code>Clearable</code>：是否可清除</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisInputImageField</code>：图片上传组件</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Receiver</code>：上传接口地址</li>
<li><code>Accept</code>：接受的文件类型</li>
<li><code>MaxSize</code>：最大文件大小（字节）</li>
<li><code>Multiple</code>：是否支持多文件</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisDateFieldAttribute</code>：日期选择组件</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Format</code>：日期格式</li>
<li><code>Placeholder</code>：占位符</li>
<li><code>MinDate</code>：最小日期</li>
<li><code>MaxDate</code>：最大日期</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisTextareaField</code>：多行文本输入框</p>
<ul>
<li><code>MaxLength</code>：最大长度</li>
<li><code>ShowCounter</code>：是否显示字符计数</li>
<li><code>Rows</code>：行数</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>通用属性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ColumnRatio</code>：字段宽度比例（12为全宽，6为半宽，4为1/3宽）</li>
<li><code>Required</code>：是否必填</li>
<li><code>Placeholder</code>：占位符文本</li>
<li><code>Disabled</code>：是否禁用</li>
<li><code>VisibleOn</code>：显示条件表达式</li>
<li><code>DisabledOn</code>：禁用条件表达式</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="23-updateemployeedto更新dto">2.3 UpdateEmployeeDto（更新DTO）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Dtos/Employee/UpdateEmployeeDto.cs
using CodeSpirit.Amis.Attributes.FormFields;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 更新职工数据传输对象
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
[FormGroup("basic", "基本信息", "EmployeeNo,Name,Gender,IdNo,BirthDate", Order = 1)]
[FormGroup("contact", "联系方式", "PhoneNumber,Email,Address", Order = 2)]
[FormGroup("work", "工作信息", "DepartmentId,Position,JobLevel,HireDate,TerminationDate,EmploymentStatus", Order = 3)]
[FormGroup("relation", "关联信息", "UserId", Order = 4)]
[FormGroup("emergency", "紧急联系人", "EmergencyContact,EmergencyPhone", Order = 5)]
[FormGroup("other", "其他信息", "AvatarUrl,Remarks,IsActive", Order = 6)]
public class UpdateEmployeeDto
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 工号
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "工号不能为空")]
    [MaxLength(50, ErrorMessage = "工号长度不能超过50个字符")]
    [DisplayName("工号")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string EmployeeNo { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 姓名
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [Required(ErrorMessage = "姓名不能为空")]
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "姓名长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [DisplayName("姓名")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 性别
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("性别")]
    [AmisFormField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public Gender Gender { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 身份证号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(18, ErrorMessage = "身份证号码长度不能超过18个字符")]
    [DisplayName("身份证号")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? IdNo { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 出生日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("出生日期")]
    [AmisDateFieldAttribute(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public DateTime? BirthDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 手机号码
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(15, ErrorMessage = "手机号码长度不能超过15个字符")]
    [Phone(ErrorMessage = "手机号码格式不正确")]
    [DisplayName("手机号码")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 电子邮箱
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "电子邮箱长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "电子邮箱格式不正确")]
    [DisplayName("电子邮箱")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 部门ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("部门")]
    [AmisInputTreeField(
        DataSource = "${ROOT_API}/api/identity/Departments/tree",
        LabelField = "name",
        ValueField = "id",
        Multiple = false,
        Searchable = true,
        ColumnRatio = 12
    )]
    public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职位
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "职位长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [DisplayName("职位")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? Position { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职级
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(50, ErrorMessage = "职级长度不能超过50个字符")]
    [DisplayName("职级")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? JobLevel { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 入职日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("入职日期")]
    [AmisDateFieldAttribute(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public DateTime? HireDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 离职日期
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("离职日期")]
    [AmisDateFieldAttribute(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public DateTime? TerminationDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 在职状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("在职状态")]
    [AmisFormField(ColumnRatio = 12)]
    public EmploymentStatus EmploymentStatus { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 关联的用户ID
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("关联用户")]
    [AmisSelectField(
        Source = "${ROOT_API}/api/identity/Users",
        ValueField = "id",
        LabelField = "name",
        Multiple = false,
        Searchable = true,
        ColumnRatio = 12
    )]
    public long? UserId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 紧急联系人
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(100, ErrorMessage = "紧急联系人长度不能超过100个字符")]
    [DisplayName("紧急联系人")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? EmergencyContact { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 紧急联系电话
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(15, ErrorMessage = "紧急联系电话长度不能超过15个字符")]
    [Phone(ErrorMessage = "紧急联系电话格式不正确")]
    [DisplayName("紧急联系电话")]
    [AmisInputTextField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public string? EmergencyPhone { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(500, ErrorMessage = "地址长度不能超过500个字符")]
    [DisplayName("地址")]
    [AmisTextareaField(ColumnRatio = 12)]
    public string? Address { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 头像地址
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(255, ErrorMessage = "头像地址长度不能超过255个字符")]
    [DisplayName("头像")]
    [AmisInputImageField(
        Receiver = "/file/api/file/images/upload?BucketName=avatar",
        Accept = "image/png,image/jpeg,image/jpg",
        MaxSize = 2097152,
        Multiple = false,
        ColumnRatio = 12
    )]
    public string? AvatarUrl { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 备注
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [MaxLength(1000, ErrorMessage = "备注长度不能超过1000个字符")]
    [DisplayName("备注")]
    [AmisTextareaField(ColumnRatio = 12)]
    public string? Remarks { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 是否激活
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("是否激活")]
    [AmisFormField(ColumnRatio = 6)]
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="24-employeequerydto查询dto">2.4 EmployeeQueryDto（查询DTO）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Dtos/Employee/EmployeeQueryDto.cs
using CodeSpirit.Amis.Attributes.FormFields;
using CodeSpirit.Core.Dtos;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工查询数据传输对象
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class EmployeeQueryDto : QueryDtoBase
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 关键字搜索（姓名、工号、身份证、手机、邮箱）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("关键字")]
    public string? Keywords { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 是否激活
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("是否激活")]
    public bool? IsActive { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 性别筛选
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("性别")]
    public Gender? Gender { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 部门ID筛选
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("部门")]
    [AmisInputTreeField(
        DataSource = "${ROOT_API}/api/identity/Departments/tree",
        Multiple = false,
        JoinValues = true,
        ExtractValue = false,
        ShowOutline = true,
        LabelField = "name",
        ValueField = "id",
        Required = false,
        Clearable = true,
        SubmitOnChange = true,
        HeightAuto = true,
        SelectFirst = false,
        InputOnly = true,
        ShowIcon = true
    )]
    [PageAside()]
    public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 在职状态筛选
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("在职状态")]
    public EmploymentStatus? EmploymentStatus { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 入职日期范围
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("入职日期")]
    public DateTime[]? HireDate { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职位
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("职位")]
    public string? Position { get; set; }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职级
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [DisplayName("职级")]
    public string? JobLevel { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<p><strong>查询DTO特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>QueryDtoBase</code>：基础查询DTO，提供了<code>Page</code>、<code>PerPage</code>、<code>OrderBy</code>、<code>OrderDir</code>、<code>Keywords</code>等分页和排序属性</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>AmisInputTreeField</code>：树形选择组件（用于查询表单）</p>
<ul>
<li><code>DataSource</code>：数据源URL</li>
<li><code>SubmitOnChange</code>：选择后自动提交查询</li>
<li><code>Searchable</code>：是否可搜索</li>
<li><code>Clearable</code>：是否可清除</li>
<li><code>ShowOutline</code>：是否显示轮廓</li>
<li><code>HeightAuto</code>：高度自适应</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><code>PageAside()</code>特性</strong>：标记该字段在页面侧边栏显示</p>
<ul>
<li>标记了此特性的字段会自动从主查询表单中排除，避免重复显示</li>
<li>特别适用于树形选择、分类筛选等需要独立展示的字段</li>
<li>侧边栏字段的变化会自动触发主内容区域的查询刷新（通过<code>SubmitOnChange</code>配置）</li>
<li>可以配置侧边栏的位置（左侧/右侧）、宽度、是否固定等属性</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>查询字段特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>查询DTO中的字段可以使用表单特性（如<code>AmisInputTreeField</code>、<code>AmisSelectField</code>等）来配置查询表单的显示</li>
<li>支持多条件组合查询，提升查询灵活性</li>
<li>枚举类型字段会自动生成下拉选择组件</li>
<li>日期类型字段可以使用<code>AmisDateFieldAttribute</code>配置日期范围选择</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="3-配置automapper映射">3. 配置AutoMapper映射</h2>
<p>在<code>MappingProfiles</code>目录下创建映射配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// MappingProfiles/EmployeeProfile.cs
using AutoMapper;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Extensions;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.MappingProfiles;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工映射配置
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class EmployeeProfile : Profile
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 构造函数
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public EmployeeProfile()
    {
        // 使用扩展方法配置基本CRUD映射（自动处理Include导航属性）
        this.ConfigureBaseCRUDIMappings&lt;
            Employee, 
            EmployeeDto, 
            long, 
            CreateEmployeeDto, 
            UpdateEmployeeDto,
            CreateEmployeeDto&gt;();
            
        // 自定义映射：映射部门名称和用户名
        CreateMap&lt;Employee, EmployeeDto&gt;()
            .ForMember(dest =&gt; dest.DepartmentName, opt =&gt; opt.MapFrom(src =&gt; src.Department != null ? src.Department.Name : null))
            .ForMember(dest =&gt; dest.UserName, opt =&gt; opt.MapFrom(src =&gt; src.User != null ? src.User.UserName : null));
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ConfigureBaseCRUDIMappings</code>扩展方法自动配置基本的CRUD映射</li>
<li>使用<code>ForMember</code>自定义字段映射逻辑，将导航属性映射到DTO</li>
<li>支持多个DTO类型的映射配置</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="4-创建服务接口和实现">4. 创建服务接口和实现</h2>
<h3 id="41-服务接口">4.1 服务接口</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Services/IEmployeeService.cs
using CodeSpirit.Core;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Services;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Services;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工服务接口
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public interface IEmployeeService : IBaseCRUDIService&lt;Employee, EmployeeDto, long, CreateEmployeeDto, UpdateEmployeeDto, EmployeeBatchImportItemDto&gt;, IScopedDependency
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 获取职工列表（分页）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="queryDto"&gt;查询条件&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;职工分页列表&lt;/returns&gt;
    Task&lt;PageList&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt; GetEmployeesAsync(EmployeeQueryDto queryDto);

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 根据部门获取职工列表
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="departmentId"&gt;部门ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="includeSubDepartments"&gt;是否包含子部门&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;职工列表&lt;/returns&gt;
    Task&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt; GetEmployeesByDepartmentAsync(long departmentId, bool includeSubDepartments = false);

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 设置职工激活状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="isActive"&gt;是否激活&lt;/param&gt;
    Task SetActiveStatusAsync(long id, bool isActive);

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 转移职工到新部门
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="employeeId"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="newDepartmentId"&gt;新部门ID&lt;/param&gt;
    Task TransferEmployeeAsync(long employeeId, long? newDepartmentId);

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 办理职工离职
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="employeeId"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="terminationDate"&gt;离职日期&lt;/param&gt;
    Task TerminateEmployeeAsync(long employeeId, DateTime terminationDate);

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 验证工号是否唯一
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="employeeNo"&gt;工号&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="excludeId"&gt;排除的职工ID（用于更新时验证）&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;是否唯一&lt;/returns&gt;
    Task&lt;bool&gt; IsEmployeeNoUniqueAsync(string employeeNo, long? excludeId = null);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="42-服务实现">4.2 服务实现</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Services/EmployeeService.cs
using AutoMapper;
using CodeSpirit.Core;
using CodeSpirit.Core.IdGenerator;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Utilities;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Repositories;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Services;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Dtos.Common;
using LinqKit;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Services;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工服务实现
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class EmployeeService : BaseCRUDIService&lt;Employee, EmployeeDto, long, CreateEmployeeDto, UpdateEmployeeDto, EmployeeBatchImportItemDto&gt;, IEmployeeService
{
    private readonly IRepository&lt;Employee&gt; _employeeRepository;
    private readonly IRepository&lt;Department&gt; _departmentRepository;
    private readonly IRepository&lt;ApplicationUser&gt; _userRepository;
    private readonly ILogger&lt;EmployeeService&gt; _logger;
    private readonly IIdGenerator _idGenerator;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IDepartmentService _departmentService;
    private readonly UserManager&lt;ApplicationUser&gt; _userManager;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 构造函数
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public EmployeeService(
        IRepository&lt;Employee&gt; employeeRepository,
        IRepository&lt;Department&gt; departmentRepository,
        IRepository&lt;ApplicationUser&gt; userRepository,
        IMapper mapper,
        ILogger&lt;EmployeeService&gt; logger,
        IIdGenerator idGenerator,
        ICurrentUser currentUser,
        ApplicationDbContext dbContext,
        IDepartmentService departmentService,
        UserManager&lt;ApplicationUser&gt; userManager,
        EnhancedBatchImportHelper&lt;EmployeeBatchImportItemDto&gt; importHelper)
        : base(employeeRepository, mapper, importHelper)
    {
        _employeeRepository = employeeRepository;
        _departmentRepository = departmentRepository;
        _userRepository = userRepository;
        _logger = logger;
        _idGenerator = idGenerator;
        _currentUser = currentUser;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _departmentService = departmentService;
        _userManager = userManager;
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 获取职工列表（分页）
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public async Task&lt;PageList&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt; GetEmployeesAsync(EmployeeQueryDto queryDto)
    {
        var predicate = PredicateBuilder.New&lt;Employee&gt;(true);

        // 应用搜索关键词过滤
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(queryDto.Keywords))
        {
            string searchLower = queryDto.Keywords.ToLower();
            predicate = predicate.Or(e =&gt; e.Name.ToLower().Contains(searchLower));
            predicate = predicate.Or(e =&gt; e.EmployeeNo.ToLower().Contains(searchLower));
            predicate = predicate.Or(e =&gt; e.IdNo.Contains(queryDto.Keywords));
            predicate = predicate.Or(e =&gt; e.PhoneNumber.Contains(queryDto.Keywords));
            predicate = predicate.Or(e =&gt; e.Email.ToLower().Contains(searchLower));
        }

        // 应用其他过滤条件
        if (queryDto.IsActive.HasValue)
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.IsActive == queryDto.IsActive.Value);
        }

        if (queryDto.Gender.HasValue)
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.Gender == queryDto.Gender.Value);
        }

        if (queryDto.DepartmentId.HasValue)
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.DepartmentId == queryDto.DepartmentId.Value);
        }

        if (queryDto.EmploymentStatus.HasValue)
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.EmploymentStatus == queryDto.EmploymentStatus.Value);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(queryDto.Position))
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.Position == queryDto.Position);
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(queryDto.JobLevel))
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.JobLevel == queryDto.JobLevel);
        }

        if (queryDto.HireDate != null &amp;&amp; queryDto.HireDate.Length == 2)
        {
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.HireDate &gt;= queryDto.HireDate[0]);
            predicate = predicate.And(e =&gt; e.HireDate &lt;= queryDto.HireDate[1]);
        }

        // 创建查询
        var query = _employeeRepository.CreateQuery()
            .Include(e =&gt; e.Department)
            .Include(e =&gt; e.User)
            .Where(predicate);

        // 执行分页查询
        var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();
        var employees = await query
            .OrderByDescending(e =&gt; e.CreatedAt)
            .Skip((queryDto.Page - 1) * queryDto.PerPage)
            .Take(queryDto.PerPage)
            .ToListAsync();

        // 映射到DTO
        var employeeDtos = Mapper.Map&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;(employees);

        // 设置关联数据
        foreach (var dto in employeeDtos)
        {
            var employee = employees.First(e =&gt; e.Id == dto.Id);
            dto.DepartmentName = employee.Department?.Name;
            dto.UserName = employee.User?.UserName;
        }

        return new PageList&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;(employeeDtos, totalCount);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 根据部门获取职工列表
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public async Task&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt; GetEmployeesByDepartmentAsync(long departmentId, bool includeSubDepartments = false)
    {
        var departmentIds = new List&lt;long&gt; { departmentId };
        
        if (includeSubDepartments)
        {
            var subDepartments = await _departmentService.GetSubDepartmentsAsync(departmentId);
            departmentIds.AddRange(subDepartments.Select(d =&gt; d.Id));
        }

        var employees = await _employeeRepository.CreateQuery()
            .Include(e =&gt; e.Department)
            .Include(e =&gt; e.User)
            .Where(e =&gt; departmentIds.Contains(e.DepartmentId ?? 0))
            .ToListAsync();

        return Mapper.Map&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;(employees);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 设置职工激活状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public async Task SetActiveStatusAsync(long id, bool isActive)
    {
        var employee = await _employeeRepository.GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (employee == null)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(404, "职工不存在");
        }

        employee.IsActive = isActive;
        await _employeeRepository.UpdateAsync(employee);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 转移职工到新部门
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public async Task TransferEmployeeAsync(long employeeId, long? newDepartmentId)
    {
        var employee = await _employeeRepository.GetByIdAsync(employeeId);
        if (employee == null)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(404, "职工不存在");
        }

        if (newDepartmentId.HasValue)
        {
            var departmentExists = await _departmentRepository.ExistsAsync(d =&gt; d.Id == newDepartmentId.Value);
            if (!departmentExists)
            {
                throw new AppServiceException(400, "部门不存在");
            }
        }

        employee.DepartmentId = newDepartmentId;
        await _employeeRepository.UpdateAsync(employee);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 办理职工离职
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public async Task TerminateEmployeeAsync(long employeeId, DateTime terminationDate)
    {
        var employee = await _employeeRepository.GetByIdAsync(employeeId);
        if (employee == null)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(404, "职工不存在");
        }

        employee.EmploymentStatus = EmploymentStatus.Resigned;
        employee.TerminationDate = terminationDate;
        employee.IsActive = false;
        
        await _employeeRepository.UpdateAsync(employee);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 验证工号是否唯一
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public async Task&lt;bool&gt; IsEmployeeNoUniqueAsync(string employeeNo, long? excludeId = null)
    {
        var query = _employeeRepository.CreateQuery()
            .Where(e =&gt; e.EmployeeNo == employeeNo &amp;&amp; e.TenantId == _currentUser.TenantId);

        if (excludeId.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e =&gt; e.Id != excludeId.Value);
        }

        return !await query.AnyAsync();
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 验证创建DTO
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    protected override async Task ValidateCreateDto(CreateEmployeeDto createDto)
    {
        await base.ValidateCreateDto(createDto);

        // 验证工号唯一性
        bool isUnique = await IsEmployeeNoUniqueAsync(createDto.EmployeeNo);
        if (!isUnique)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(400, $"工号 {createDto.EmployeeNo} 已存在，请使用其他工号");
        }

        // 验证部门是否存在
        if (createDto.DepartmentId.HasValue)
        {
            var departmentExists = await _departmentRepository.ExistsAsync(d =&gt; d.Id == createDto.DepartmentId.Value);
            if (!departmentExists)
            {
                throw new AppServiceException(400, "部门不存在");
            }
        }

        // 验证用户是否存在（如果指定了用户ID）
        if (createDto.UserId.HasValue)
        {
            var userExists = await _userRepository.ExistsAsync(u =&gt; u.Id == createDto.UserId.Value);
            if (!userExists)
            {
                throw new AppServiceException(400, "用户不存在");
            }
        }
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 验证更新DTO
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    protected override async Task ValidateUpdateDto(long id, UpdateEmployeeDto updateDto)
    {
        await base.ValidateUpdateDto(id, updateDto);

        // 验证工号唯一性（排除当前记录）
        bool isUnique = await IsEmployeeNoUniqueAsync(updateDto.EmployeeNo, id);
        if (!isUnique)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(400, $"工号 {updateDto.EmployeeNo} 已存在，请使用其他工号");
        }

        // 验证部门是否存在
        if (updateDto.DepartmentId.HasValue)
        {
            var departmentExists = await _departmentRepository.ExistsAsync(d =&gt; d.Id == updateDto.DepartmentId.Value);
            if (!departmentExists)
            {
                throw new AppServiceException(400, "部门不存在");
            }
        }

        // 验证用户是否存在（如果指定了用户ID）
        if (updateDto.UserId.HasValue)
        {
            var userExists = await _userRepository.ExistsAsync(u =&gt; u.Id == updateDto.UserId.Value);
            if (!userExists)
            {
                throw new AppServiceException(400, "用户不存在");
            }
        }
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 创建实体前的处理
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    protected override async Task&lt;Employee&gt; OnCreating(CreateEmployeeDto createDto)
    {
        var employee = await base.OnCreating(createDto);
        
        // 设置租户ID
        employee.TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId;
        
        // 生成ID（如果需要）
        if (employee.Id == 0)
        {
            employee.Id = await _idGenerator.GenerateIdAsync();
        }

        return employee;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>继承自<code>BaseCRUDIService</code>，自动获得标准的CRUD方法和批量导入功能</li>
<li>实现<code>IScopedDependency</code>接口，服务会自动注册</li>
<li>重写<code>ValidateCreateDto</code>和<code>ValidateUpdateDto</code>方法实现业务验证（工号唯一性、部门存在性等）</li>
<li>重写<code>OnCreating</code>方法设置租户ID和生成ID</li>
<li>使用<code>LinqKit</code>的<code>PredicateBuilder</code>构建动态查询条件</li>
<li>提供额外的业务方法（设置激活状态、转移部门、办理离职等）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="5-创建控制器">5. 创建控制器</h2>
<p>在<code>Controllers</code>目录下创建控制器：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Controllers/EmployeesController.cs
using CodeSpirit.Core;
using CodeSpirit.Core.Attributes;
using CodeSpirit.Core.Dtos;
using CodeSpirit.Core.Enums;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Dtos.Employee;
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Services;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Dtos.Common;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Controllers;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 职工管理控制器
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
[DisplayName("职工管理")]
[Navigation(Icon = "fa-solid fa-user-tie", PlatformType = PlatformType.Tenant)]
public class EmployeesController : ApiControllerBase
{
    private readonly IEmployeeService _employeeService;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 构造函数
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public EmployeesController(IEmployeeService employeeService)
    {
        _employeeService = employeeService;
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 获取职工列表
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="queryDto"&gt;查询条件&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;职工列表结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpGet]
    [DisplayName("获取职工列表")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PageList&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt; GetEmployees([FromQuery] EmployeeQueryDto queryDto)
    {
        var employees = await _employeeService.GetEmployeesAsync(queryDto);
        return SuccessResponse(employees);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 根据部门获取职工列表
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="departmentId"&gt;部门ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="includeSubDepartments"&gt;是否包含子部门&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;职工列表&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpGet("department/{departmentId}")]
    [DisplayName("根据部门获取职工")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt; GetEmployeesByDepartment(
        long departmentId, 
        [FromQuery] bool includeSubDepartments = false)
    {
        var employees = await _employeeService.GetEmployeesByDepartmentAsync(departmentId, includeSubDepartments);
        return SuccessResponse(employees);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 获取职工详情
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;职工详细信息&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpGet("{id:long}")]
    [DisplayName("获取职工详情")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;&gt; GetEmployee(long id)
    {
        var employee = await _employeeService.GetAsync(id);
        return SuccessResponse(employee);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 创建职工
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="createDto"&gt;创建职工请求数据&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;创建的职工信息&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpPost]
    [DisplayName("创建职工")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;&gt; CreateEmployee(CreateEmployeeDto createDto)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(createDto);
        var employeeDto = await _employeeService.CreateAsync(createDto);
        return SuccessResponse(employeeDto);
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 更新职工
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="updateDto"&gt;更新职工请求数据&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;更新操作结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpPut("{id:long}")]
    [DisplayName("更新职工")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&gt;&gt; UpdateEmployee(long id, UpdateEmployeeDto updateDto)
    {
        await _employeeService.UpdateAsync(id, updateDto);
        return SuccessResponse();
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 删除职工
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;删除操作结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpDelete("{id:long}")]
    [Operation("删除", "ajax", null, "确定要删除此职工吗？")]
    [DisplayName("删除职工")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&gt;&gt; DeleteEmployee(long id)
    {
        await _employeeService.DeleteAsync(id);
        return SuccessResponse();
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 批量删除职工
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="request"&gt;批量删除请求&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;批量删除操作结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpPost("batch-delete")]
    [Operation("批量删除", "ajax", null, "确定要批量删除选中的职工吗？", isBulkOperation: true)]
    [DisplayName("批量删除职工")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&gt;&gt; BatchDeleteEmployees([FromBody] BatchOperationDto&lt;long&gt; request)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);
        (int successCount, List&lt;long&gt; failedIds) = await _employeeService.BatchDeleteAsync(request.Ids);
        
        return failedIds.Any()
            ? SuccessResponse($"成功删除 {successCount} 个职工，但以下职工删除失败: {string.Join(", ", failedIds)}")
            : SuccessResponse($"成功删除 {successCount} 个职工！");
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 设置职工激活状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="isActive"&gt;是否激活&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;操作结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpPut("{id:long}/active")]
    [DisplayName("设置激活状态")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&gt;&gt; SetActiveStatus(long id, [FromBody] bool isActive)
    {
        await _employeeService.SetActiveStatusAsync(id, isActive);
        return SuccessResponse();
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 转移职工到新部门
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="request"&gt;转移请求&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;操作结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpPut("{id:long}/transfer")]
    [DisplayName("转移部门")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&gt;&gt; TransferEmployee(long id, [FromBody] TransferEmployeeRequest request)
    {
        await _employeeService.TransferEmployeeAsync(id, request.DepartmentId);
        return SuccessResponse();
    }

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 办理职工离职
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="id"&gt;职工ID&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="request"&gt;离职请求&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;操作结果&lt;/returns&gt;
    [HttpPut("{id:long}/terminate")]
    [DisplayName("办理离职")]
    public async Task&lt;ActionResult&lt;ApiResponse&gt;&gt; TerminateEmployee(long id, [FromBody] TerminateEmployeeRequest request)
    {
        await _employeeService.TerminateEmployeeAsync(id, request.TerminationDate);
        return SuccessResponse();
    }
}

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 转移职工请求
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class TransferEmployeeRequest
{
    public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }
}

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 离职请求
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class TerminateEmployeeRequest
{
    public DateTime TerminationDate { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>继承自<code>ApiControllerBase</code>，自动获得统一的响应格式和异常处理</li>
<li><code>DisplayName</code>特性用于前端界面显示</li>
<li><code>Navigation</code>特性用于添加到导航菜单</li>
<li><code>Operation</code>特性用于配置操作按钮（删除确认对话框）</li>
<li>使用<code>SuccessResponse</code>方法返回统一的成功响应</li>
<li>提供额外的业务操作接口（设置激活状态、转移部门、办理离职等）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="6-配置数据库上下文">6. 配置数据库上下文</h2>
<p>在<code>Data</code>目录下的DbContext中添加实体：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Data/ApplicationDbContext.cs
using CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data.Models;
using CodeSpirit.Shared.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace CodeSpirit.IdentityApi.Data;

/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 身份认证系统数据库上下文 - 支持多租户和多数据库
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class ApplicationDbContext : MultiDatabaseDbContextBase
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 职工
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public DbSet&lt;Employee&gt; Employees =&gt; Set&lt;Employee&gt;();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // 配置Employee实体
        modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Employee&gt;(entity =&gt;
        {
            entity.ToTable(nameof(Employee));
            entity.Property(e =&gt; e.Id).ValueGeneratedNever();

            // 租户感知的工号复合唯一索引：同一租户内工号唯一
            entity.HasIndex(e =&gt; new { e.TenantId, e.EmployeeNo })
                .IsUnique()
                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Employee_TenantId_EmployeeNo");

            // 索引 DepartmentId，提高查询部门员工的性能
            entity.HasIndex(e =&gt; e.DepartmentId)
                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Employee_DepartmentId");

            // 索引 UserId，提高查询用户关联的性能
            entity.HasIndex(e =&gt; e.UserId)
                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Employee_UserId");

            // 索引 IsActive，提高按状态过滤的性能
            entity.HasIndex(e =&gt; e.IsActive)
                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Employee_IsActive");

            // 索引 EmploymentStatus，提高按在职状态过滤的性能
            entity.HasIndex(e =&gt; e.EmploymentStatus)
                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Employee_EmploymentStatus");

            // 配置与部门的关系
            entity.HasOne(e =&gt; e.Department)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(e =&gt; e.DepartmentId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

            // 配置与用户的关系
            entity.HasOne(e =&gt; e.User)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(e =&gt; e.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);
        });
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>继承自<code>MultiDatabaseDbContextBase</code>，支持MySQL和SQL Server</li>
<li>配置表名、主键、字段长度等</li>
<li>配置复合唯一索引（租户ID + 工号），确保同一租户内工号唯一</li>
<li>配置关联关系的级联删除策略（SetNull表示删除部门或用户时，职工记录保留但关联字段设为null）</li>
<li>添加必要的索引提升查询性能</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="7-服务注册">7. 服务注册</h2>
<p>CodeSpirit框架通过标记接口自动注册服务，无需手动注册：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// IEmployeeService接口继承了IScopedDependency接口
public interface IEmployeeService : IBaseCRUDIService&lt;...&gt;, IScopedDependency
{
    // ...
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>服务接口继承<code>IScopedDependency</code>接口，服务会自动注册为Scoped生命周期</li>
<li>框架会自动扫描并注册所有标记接口的服务</li>
<li>无需在<code>Program.cs</code>中手动注册</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="8-创建数据库迁移">8. 创建数据库迁移</h2>
<p>CodeSpirit框架支持多数据库架构，迁移文件按数据库类型分离存储。创建迁移时必须指定迁移目录参数。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 进入IdentityApi项目目录
cd Src/ApiServices/CodeSpirit.IdentityApi

# 创建迁移（根据数据库类型选择）
# MySQL - 迁移文件将保存到 Migrations/MySql/ 目录
dotnet ef migrations add AddEmployees --context MySqlApplicationDbContext --output-dir Migrations/MySql

# SQL Server - 迁移文件将保存到 Migrations/SqlServer/ 目录
dotnet ef migrations add AddEmployees --context SqlServerApplicationDbContext --output-dir Migrations/SqlServer

# 应用迁移
dotnet ef database update --context MySqlApplicationDbContext
# 或
dotnet ef database update --context SqlServerApplicationDbContext
</code></pre>
<p><strong>迁移目录结构</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>Src/ApiServices/CodeSpirit.IdentityApi/
├── Migrations/
│   ├── MySql/                          # MySQL迁移文件
│   │   ├── 20251222_AddEmployees.cs
│   │   ├── 20251222_AddEmployees.Designer.cs
│   │   └── MySqlApplicationDbContextModelSnapshot.cs
│   └── SqlServer/                      # SQL Server迁移文件
│       ├── 20251222_AddEmployees.cs
│       ├── 20251222_AddEmployees.Designer.cs
│       └── SqlServerApplicationDbContextModelSnapshot.cs
</code></pre>
<p><strong>说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>--output-dir</code>参数用于指定迁移文件的输出目录</li>
<li>MySQL迁移文件必须保存到<code>Migrations/MySql/</code>目录</li>
<li>SQL Server迁移文件必须保存到<code>Migrations/SqlServer/</code>目录</li>
<li>每个数据库类型都有独立的<code>ModelSnapshot.cs</code>文件</li>
<li>这样可以确保不同数据库类型的迁移文件互不干扰</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="功能特性">功能特性</h2>
<p>通过以上步骤，您已经完成了一个完整的CRUD功能开发。CodeSpirit框架会自动提供以下功能：</p>
<h3 id="自动生成的功能">自动生成的功能</h3>
<ul>
<li>✅ <strong>AMIS前端界面</strong>：基于控制器和DTO的特性自动生成
<ul>
<li>表格展示（支持头像、日期格式化、状态显示等）</li>
<li>表单编辑（支持表单分组、树形选择、图片上传等）</li>
<li>多条件搜索筛选（关键字、部门、状态、日期范围等）</li>
<li>批量操作（批量删除等）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>✅ <strong>统一的API响应格式</strong>：使用<code>ApiResponse&lt;T&gt;</code>统一响应</li>
<li>✅ <strong>分页查询</strong>：支持分页、排序、多条件筛选</li>
<li>✅ <strong>批量操作</strong>：支持批量删除、批量导入等操作</li>
<li>✅ <strong>异常处理</strong>：统一的异常处理和错误响应</li>
<li>✅ <strong>权限控制</strong>：支持基于特性的权限控制</li>
<li>✅ <strong>审计日志</strong>：自动记录创建、更新、删除操作</li>
<li>✅ <strong>多租户支持</strong>：自动进行数据隔离</li>
<li>✅ <strong>软删除支持</strong>：删除操作使用软删除，数据可恢复</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="标准crud操作">标准CRUD操作</h3>
<table>

<tr>

<h2 id="业务验证示例">业务验证示例</h2>
<h3 id="创建时验证">创建时验证</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">protected override async Task ValidateCreateDto(CreateEmployeeDto createDto)
{
    await base.ValidateCreateDto(createDto);

    // 验证工号唯一性
    bool isUnique = await IsEmployeeNoUniqueAsync(createDto.EmployeeNo);
    if (!isUnique)
    {
        throw new AppServiceException(400, $"工号 {createDto.EmployeeNo} 已存在，请使用其他工号");
    }

    // 验证部门是否存在
    if (createDto.DepartmentId.HasValue)
    {
        var departmentExists = await _departmentRepository.ExistsAsync(d =&gt; d.Id == createDto.DepartmentId.Value);
        if (!departmentExists)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(400, "部门不存在");
        }
    }

    // 验证用户是否存在（如果指定了用户ID）
    if (createDto.UserId.HasValue)
    {
        var userExists = await _userRepository.ExistsAsync(u =&gt; u.Id == createDto.UserId.Value);
        if (!userExists)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(400, "用户不存在");
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="更新时验证">更新时验证</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">protected override async Task ValidateUpdateDto(long id, UpdateEmployeeDto updateDto)
{
    await base.ValidateUpdateDto(id, updateDto);

    // 验证工号唯一性（排除当前记录）
    bool isUnique = await IsEmployeeNoUniqueAsync(updateDto.EmployeeNo, id);
    if (!isUnique)
    {
        throw new AppServiceException(400, $"工号 {updateDto.EmployeeNo} 已存在，请使用其他工号");
    }

    // 验证部门是否存在
    if (updateDto.DepartmentId.HasValue)
    {
        var departmentExists = await _departmentRepository.ExistsAsync(d =&gt; d.Id == updateDto.DepartmentId.Value);
        if (!departmentExists)
        {
            throw new AppServiceException(400, "部门不存在");
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="创建前处理">创建前处理</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">protected override async Task&lt;Employee&gt; OnCreating(CreateEmployeeDto createDto)
{
    var employee = await base.OnCreating(createDto);
    
    // 设置租户ID
    employee.TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId;
    
    // 生成ID（如果需要）
    if (employee.Id == 0)
    {
        employee.Id = await _idGenerator.GenerateIdAsync();
    }

    return employee;
}
</code></pre>

}

<h3 id="自定义查询方法">自定义查询方法</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取在职职工列表
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public async Task&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt; GetActiveEmployeesAsync()
{
    var employees = await Repository.CreateQuery()
        .Where(e =&gt; e.IsActive &amp;&amp; e.EmploymentStatus == EmploymentStatus.Active)
        .Include(e =&gt; e.Department)
        .Include(e =&gt; e.User)
        .ToListAsync();

    return Mapper.Map&lt;List&lt;EmployeeDto&gt;&gt;(employees);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="使用pageaside特性实现侧边栏筛选">使用PageAside特性实现侧边栏筛选</h3>
<p><code>PageAside()</code>特性用于将查询字段放置在页面侧边栏，特别适用于树形选择、分类筛选等场景。使用此特性后，该字段会从主查询表单中移除，仅在侧边栏显示。</p>
<p><strong>特性说明</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 部门ID筛选
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
[DisplayName("部门")]
[AmisInputTreeField(
    DataSource = "${ROOT_API}/api/identity/Departments/tree",
    Multiple = false,
    JoinValues = true,
    ExtractValue = false,
    ShowOutline = true,
    LabelField = "name",
    ValueField = "id",
    Required = false,
    Clearable = true,
    SubmitOnChange = true,  // 选择后自动提交查询
    HeightAuto = true,
    SelectFirst = false,
    InputOnly = true,
    ShowIcon = true
)]
[PageAside()]  // 标记为侧边栏字段
public long? DepartmentId { get; set; }
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/70544/202512/70544-20251223170759720-1961586904.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<strong>PageAside特性的主要属性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Target</code>：表单提交目标，如果为空则自动设置为CRUD组件名称</li>
<li><code>SubmitOnInit</code>：是否在初始化时提交，默认为<code>false</code></li>
<li><code>WrapWithPanel</code>：是否不使用面板包装，默认为<code>false</code></li>
<li><code>AsideResizor</code>：侧边栏宽度是否可调整，默认为<code>true</code></li>
<li><code>AsideMinWidth</code>：侧边栏最小宽度（像素），默认为<code>0</code></li>
<li><code>AsideMaxWidth</code>：侧边栏最大宽度（像素），默认为<code>0</code></li>
<li><code>AsideSticky</code>：侧边栏是否固定，默认为<code>true</code></li>
<li><code>AsidePosition</code>：侧边栏位置（<code>Left</code>/<code>Right</code>），默认为<code>Left</code></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>使用场景</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>树形分类筛选</strong>：如部门树、分类树等，放在侧边栏作为导航筛选器</li>
<li><strong>独立筛选器</strong>：需要独立展示的筛选条件，避免主表单过于拥挤</li>
<li><strong>联动查询</strong>：侧边栏字段变化时自动触发主内容区域刷新</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>注意事项</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>标记了<code>PageAside()</code>特性的字段会自动从主查询表单中排除</li>
<li>建议配合<code>SubmitOnChange = true</code>使用，实现选择后自动查询</li>
<li>侧边栏字段的查询条件会自动合并到主查询中</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="最佳实践">最佳实践</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>实体设计</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>实现<code>IFullAuditable</code>接口获得完整的审计字段（创建、更新、删除）</li>
<li>实现<code>IMultiTenant</code>接口支持多租户数据隔离</li>
<li>实现<code>IIsActive</code>接口支持激活状态管理</li>
<li>合理设计导航属性，使用<code>Include</code>避免N+1查询问题</li>
<li>为唯一性字段创建复合唯一索引（租户ID + 业务字段）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>DTO分离</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>为创建、更新、查询分别创建DTO</li>
<li>使用<code>DisplayName</code>特性提供友好的字段名称</li>
<li>使用<code>AmisColumn</code>特性控制前端表格列显示</li>
<li>使用<code>FormGroup</code>特性将表单字段分组，提升用户体验</li>
<li>使用<code>AmisInputTreeField</code>等特性自动生成合适的表单组件</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>服务层</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>继承<code>BaseCRUDIService</code>获得CRUD和批量导入功能</li>
<li>服务接口继承<code>IScopedDependency</code>接口自动注册</li>
<li>重写<code>ValidateCreateDto</code>和<code>ValidateUpdateDto</code>实现业务验证</li>
<li>重写<code>OnCreating</code>方法设置租户ID和生成ID</li>
<li>使用<code>LinqKit</code>的<code>PredicateBuilder</code>构建动态查询条件</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>控制器</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>保持简洁，主要调用服务层方法</li>
<li>使用<code>DisplayName</code>和<code>Navigation</code>特性</li>
<li>使用<code>Operation</code>特性配置操作按钮（删除确认对话框）</li>
<li>提供额外的业务操作接口（如设置激活状态、转移部门等）</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>验证</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>使用DataAnnotations进行基础数据验证</li>
<li>重写服务层的验证方法实现业务验证（唯一性、关联存在性等）</li>
<li>使用<code>AppServiceException</code>抛出业务异常</li>
<li>在数据库层面创建唯一索引确保数据完整性</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>数据库设计</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>为常用查询字段创建索引提升性能</li>
<li>合理配置关联关系的级联删除策略</li>
<li>使用复合唯一索引确保租户内业务字段唯一性</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>文档注释</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>为所有公共成员添加XML文档注释</li>
<li>使用<code>&lt;summary&gt;</code>、<code>&lt;param&gt;</code>、<code>&lt;returns&gt;</code>标签</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<p>通过CodeSpirit框架的<code>BaseCRUDIService</code>和标准开发模式，您可以快速开发出功能完整的CRUD接口。职工管理模块展示了：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 标准CRUD操作的实现</li>
<li>✅ 关联关系管理（部门、用户账号）</li>
<li>✅ 业务验证逻辑的编写（工号唯一性、部门存在性等）</li>
<li>✅ 多条件查询的实现（关键字、部门、状态、日期范围等）</li>
<li>✅ 表单分组展示的使用</li>
<li>✅ 额外业务操作的实现（设置激活状态、转移部门、办理离职等）</li>
<li>✅ AMIS特性的使用（表格列、表单字段、图片上传等）</li>
</ul>
<p>框架会自动处理大部分样板代码，让您专注于业务逻辑的实现。</p>
